text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summoned to the cafeteria, 
I found Daring Tact and Daring Heart 
surrounding a table piled high with 
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I gave everyone back in 
Hidaka an update. 
When I mentioned how much you and Daring 
Heart 
have been looking out for me—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"They sent all of this over. 
Saying, 'Please share and enjoy it 
together.'"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking another look at the table, it was 
overflowing 
with produce from Hidaka: fresh 
vegetables, seafood, 
and even game meat like venison.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It just shows how much Tact is loved! 
That's so lovely!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I am truly grateful. 
They've always treated me so well—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"And everything they sent happens to be 
what I love most and used to eat often."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I really wanted both of you 
to enjoy it while it's still fresh..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"So that we can savor it together with 
all the heartfelt love the people of 
Hidaka put into it...!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good to me! 
Well then, I'm gonna eat until 
I'm completely stuffed today!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I felt it was definitely far too 
much food, 
I completely understood Daring Tact's 
feelings. 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You're right, that sounds wonderful too! 
In that case, the first one who comes to 
mind is—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—What is that amazing smell?! 
The voice of destiny itself commands me to 
follow my nose!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Epiphaneia?! What brings you here...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Though, your timing couldn't be better. 
These were sent to me by the folks back 
home in my hometown, and—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Since you've taken such great care of me, 
I'd really love for you to have some...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious?! I'm thrilled! 
My stomach has been growling like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—I see! The reason I've been running 
around all day 
was all so this meal would taste even more 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad. 
Shall we get cooking right away and eat?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside Daring Tact and the 
others, 
we feasted upon the fresh ingredients from 
Hidaka.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's enjoy it together!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get ready right away! 
We can borrow the kitchen for cooking, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! I happen to have some 
barbecue rub 
that will pair wonderfully with this meat.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
With beef this exquisite, I'm sure it's 
delicious 
all on its own, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Since we're all here, would you mind 
if I added a little flavor from my own 
hometown?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! Thank you so much, Daring Heart! 
I'd love to try it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled! 
Hehe, this is going to be quite a 
delightful party!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three of us happily 
polished off 
every last bite of the fresh ingredients.
